label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Haha Sneha it's fine, he's right to ask. Sorry for the late reply Rohan, wanted to answer properly and not just send a thumbs up and run away.

Straight answer first. Yes, last Friday I let go 6 out of 14 people. Gave everyone 2 months pay and we've already got 4 of them interviews. Honestly that was the worst day of my life. Worse than failing maths in 2nd sem, and you all remember how I was after that 😅

What happened: we had a bridge round lined up with a fund in Hyderabad. Term sheet was basically ready. Then on 28 Oct it fell through. The partner told me on the call "we love the energy" and then didn't reply for 11 days. So I've now learnt that "we love the energy" means "bye" in VC language. Ajay, that LinkedIn post was me trying not to cry in corporate English, so you can stop with the cricket captain jokes. Ok fine, you can continue, it was a bit like that.

Where we are now: after the cuts we have around 5 months of runway. App has about 41k monthly users. The plumber and electrician side is actually growing, which is the good part. The AC servicing side is burning money like anything, so we're shutting it down. The plan is to go all in on housing society tie-ups. 3 societies in HSR have already signed up for pilots, so it's not just a slide in a deck, there are real people who've said yes.

Now the 3 lakh, since you asked straight. Your and Divya's money is at risk. It's not gone, but it's at risk, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. I genuinely think we have a real shot with the societies thing. I also know it's not a sure thing, and I'm not going to sit here and promise you it's safe when I don't actually know. You both put in real money because you trusted me, same terms as everyone else in the friends round in 2025, and you have every right to ask "is it still a thing." Tell Divya it is still a thing. It's just a thing that's having a tough time right now.

So no sad face needed yet. Maybe keep it ready in the drawer, but don't take it out.

What I'd like to do is get on a proper call with you and Divya this week. I'll show you the actual numbers, the burn, the runway, how the societies pilots are going, all of it. Easier to ask whatever you want with the real picture in front of you than me typing essays in the group. Tell me which evening works and I'll block it.

And for everyone else, before anyone starts a fundraiser for me, I'm fine. I'm eating Maggi in office at 11pm so often that the security uncle now asks me "masala or plain sir" without me even saying anything. That's the kind of relationship I have now. Amma asked me last week if TCS is still hiring. I told her I'll check. I did not check.

Anyway, Saturday I'm coming, 100%. Pranav is buying, that's already decided, no discussion. Pranav you wanted dosa and beer, I'll take you to a place where you can do both and also listen to me explain unit economics for 2 hours. Free of cost. You're welcome.

Rohan, thanks for asking straight da. I'd rather you ask than sit there wondering. Let's talk this week properly 🙏
